prompts.title: Low Duel Under the Floodlights
prompts.prompt: Referential photorealistic illustration, vertical 9:16, 2K, composed with a quiet lower third left open for subtitles. Night match between Sevilla FC and Deportivo Alavés, framed from an ultra-low angle at pitch level: a Sevilla FC winger in the white home shirt with red trim, white shorts and red socks lunges past a Deportivo Alavés full-back in the blue-and-white striped shirt, both sprinting shoulder to shoulder, boots clawing for a ball rolling loose across freshly cut, damp November grass. Realistic adult anatomy, balanced athletic strides, plausible football physics as the ball squirms between studs. Cold floodlight pools from high above, crisp along the shoulders, grass blades catching fine detail. Club crests visible on chests, kit colours faithful; no scoreboard, captions or readable sponsors, dugout blurred behind. Illustrative duel of the two sides, not documentation of any real event, score, lineup or player.
